about: Surat-based maker of lab-grown diamond (LGD) studded gold jewellery, selling mainly B2B to retail chains, standalone retailers and wholesalers across 18 states and 2 UTs. Since July 2025 it also runs a D2C brand, Ayaani (online plus 10 stores). One manufacturing facility in Surat with about 360 kg per annum installed capacity and over 32,000 designs.

objects.purpose: Funding working capital requirements of the Company
General corporate purposes (capped at 25% of gross proceeds)

promoters.background: Promoters have about 29 years combined jewellery-industry experience; Rajnikant Chanchad has over 20 years. Holds 52.02% and Sonalben 3.98%; Dhruv Savaliya holds nil.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 55.49% of FY26 revenue (76.68% FY25, 84.24% FY24). Top 10 suppliers were 86.16% of FY26 purchases. Five states gave 85.03% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: No outstanding criminal or material civil cases against the Company, subsidiaries or directors. One direct tax demand of Rs 29.51 million (about Rs 2.95 crore) for AY 2023-24 against the Company. Several delayed ROC filings were regularised with additional fees.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 53.7 crore in FY24 to Rs 202.9 crore in FY26, with PAT rising from Rs 4.0 crore to Rs 22.3 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 10.21% to 15.27% and PAT margin from 7.50% to 11.00% over FY24-FY26.
RoNW of 43.75% and RoCE of 42.93% in FY26, well above listed peers at 6-19% RoNW.
Integrated model: in-house design (over 32,000 designs), manufacturing in Surat with 122 karigars, B2B supply plus D2C brand Ayaani.
Customer base widened to 323 B2B customers in FY26 from 74 in FY24, lowering top-10 customer share to 55.49%.
Focus on affordable lightweight LGD jewellery; CareEdge projects the Indian LGD jewellery market to grow at about 15.8% CAGR from CY25 to CY30.
Low leverage: debt-equity ratio of 0.29 in FY26 against 0.69 in FY24.
Clients include organised retailers such as GIVA, Palmonas, ONYA and Ladia Diamonds.

risks.title: Operating cash flow negative every year
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was about -Rs 14.7 crore in FY26, -Rs 10.1 crore in FY25 and -Rs 1.1 crore in FY24 despite reported profits. Receivables and inventory growth absorb cash.

risks.title: Very working-capital heavy business
risks.detail: Working capital requirement rose from Rs 6.8 crore in FY24 to Rs 44.9 crore in FY26 (Rs 110.3 crore estimated for FY27). Inventory days went from 31 to 81. Rs 70 crore of the IPO goes to working capital.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 B2B customers contributed 55.49% of FY26 revenue (76.68% FY25, 84.24% FY24). Losing a few customers could hit revenue sharply.

risks.title: Supplier concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers were 86.16% of FY26 purchases (94.31% FY25). Gold and lab-grown diamond supply or price changes could hurt margins.

risks.title: Single small facility
risks.detail: All manufacturing is at one Surat facility of about 7,000 sq. ft. Disruption, machinery failure or quality issues would affect the whole business; capacity utilisation has been low.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.detail: Gujarat, Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra gave 85.03% of FY26 revenue (92.71% FY25, 94.44% FY24).

risks.title: Short track record and recent acquisition
risks.detail: Company began operating in July 2022. FY26 is the first Ind AS year, and the July 2025 acquisition of Ayaani (previously a key customer) adds D2C and lease obligations of about Rs 14.3 crore.

risks.title: Compliance lapses and tax demand
risks.detail: Several ROC filings were delayed and later regularised with fees. A direct tax demand of Rs 2.95 crore for AY 2023-24 is outstanding. Object of the issue is not appraised by any bank.
